product_metadata.title: Whitmor Rolling Underbed Storage Cart
features: Contain clutter and maximize unused under bed space for out of sight storage
Multiuse for under couches, coffee tables and cabinets
Elevated design keeps clothes, shoes, bags, and more off floor where dust and dirt can settle
Underbed organizer equipped with heavy duty wheels for quick access
Underbed rolling cart has a steel grid, heavy duty frame with a white epoxy finish
Whitmor's Service Guarantee - we stand by our products, if you have any problems, contact us for help
SERVICE AND GUARANTEE: Whitmor stands by our products. If you have any problems, contact us for help
description: Since the underbed cart rolls on wheels, it is convenient to store not only under a bed, but also under hanging clothes, in the garage and travel trailers/motor homes where storage is limited. Made of durable steel and coated with white epoxy. Use to store blankets, linens, toys, all kinds of items. The caster wheels are made of heavy duty plastic and allows cart mobility. Screws are self tapping screw.
